title: [YSQL] Indexes on system catalog tables are not updated during DDL
body:
This is currently a known issue that indexes on system catalog tables are not updated during DDL. This can lead this incorrect result when querying the tables using the indexes.

E.g.

```
postgres=# create table t (k int primary key);
CREATE TABLE
postgres=# select * from pg_type where typname = 't';
 typname | typnamespace | typowner | typlen | typbyval | typtype | typcategory | typispreferred | typisdefined | typdelim | typrelid | typelem | typarray | typinput  | typoutput  | typreceive  |   typsend   | typmodin | typmodout | typanalyze | typalign | typstorage | typnotnull | typbasetype | typtypmod | typndims | typcollation | typdefaultbin | typdefault | typacl
---------+--------------+----------+--------+----------+---------+-------------+----------------+--------------+----------+----------+---------+----------+-----------+------------+-------------+-------------+----------+-----------+------------+----------+------------+------------+-------------+-----------+----------+--------------+---------------+------------+--------
 t       |         2200 |       10 |     -1 | f        | c       | C           | f              | t            | ,        |    26384 |       0 |    26385 | record_in | record_out | record_recv | record_send | -        | -         | -          | d        | x          | f          |           0 |        -1 |        0 |            0 |               |            |
(1 row)

postgres=# alter table t rename to t2;
ALTER TABLE
postgres=# select * from pg_type where typname = 't';
 typname | typnamespace | typowner | typlen | typbyval | typtype | typcategory | typispreferred | typisdefined | typdelim | typrelid | typelem | typarray | typinput  | typoutput  | typreceive  |   typsend   | typmodin | typmodout | typanalyze | typalign | typstorage | typnotnull | typbasetype | typtypmod | typndims | typcollation | typdefaultbin | typdefault | typacl
---------+--------------+----------+--------+----------+---------+-------------+----------------+--------------+----------+----------+---------+----------+-----------+------------+-------------+-------------+----------+-----------+------------+----------+------------+------------+-------------+-----------+----------+--------------+---------------+------------+--------
 t2      |         2200 |       10 |     -1 | f        | c       | C           | f              | t            | ,        |    26384 |       0 |    26385 | record_in | record_out | record_recv | record_send | -        | -         | -          | d        | x          | f          |           0 |        -1 |        0 |            0 |               |            |
(1 row)
```
